summary: Backend-only test of the Google Drive OAuth graceful-error fix and auth/dossier regression. All 9 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified /api/drive/connect returns a valid Google authorization_url with client_id/redirect_uri/scope; /api/drive/status returns {connected:false, configured:true}; /api/drive/callback returns a 307 redirect to /admin?drive=error for (a) ?error=access_denied, (b) ?code=invalid_fake_code (real Google token exchange failure), and (c) no params — no 500s. Regression: admin login, patient login, /api/health, and /api/dossiers (patient) all work.
action_items: User must re-copy a valid GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from Google Cloud Console to enable the real Drive OAuth success path (out of scope for automated testing).
critical_code_review_comments: drive_callback correctly wraps flow.fetch_token in try/except and returns RedirectResponse to FRONTEND_URL/admin?drive=error for all failure modes (missing code, OAuth error, token exchange exception) — matches requested behavior.
server.py is 923 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, dossiers, drive, payments) for maintainability.

rca of the issue: Original bug: oauthlib InvalidClientError at flow.fetch_token in /api/drive/callback caused HTTP 500. RCA: invalid GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in env. Fix (verified): endpoint now catches exceptions and redirects to FRONTEND_URL/admin?drive=error instead of 500.
